question: Should OpenClaw accept this curated OpenRouter Images API routing now, or pause the PR behind the broader OpenRouter image catalog policy?
rationale: The PR is more than a mechanical model-list update because it changes endpoint routing for credential-backed OpenRouter image models and extends image-generation capability metadata, so maintainer product intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept After Rebase
options.body: Rebase onto current main, preserve current capability helpers, and merge the curated `/images` route with the documented compatibility behavior.

options.title: Narrow The Curated Set
options.body: Land only the model IDs and limits maintainers are comfortable owning now, leaving broader OpenRouter image discovery to the linked issue.

options.title: Pause For Catalog Policy
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it in favor of the linked issue if maintainers want dynamic discovery or a different catalog strategy instead of a curated provider table.

recommendation.title: Accept After Rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, preserve current capability helpers, and merge the curated `/images` route with the documented compatibility behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans image-generation runtime behavior, provider policy, and plugin/provider compatibility where the history shows strong adjacent ownership.
